comment: Silph Co. 11F: Giovanni boss battle, the President's Master Ball, and Saffron's liberation - the script that sets the two story flags Sabrina's gym record consumes (data/gym_requirements.json kanto_gym_6_sabrina: saffron_access + silph_co_cleared; the gym record's own notes define silph_co_cleared as set 'when the occupation is lifted', and the kanto story audit groups both flags under this beat - PUW canon makes the Rocket occupation Saffron's story gate).
